edits.old: - The release date 30 November 2026 is tentative; a date is not a condition of this story.
edits.new:
- The release date 30 November 2026 is tentative; a date is not a condition of this story.
- Notice generation is driven through POST /cases/{caseId}/notices on rwb-comms (GAP-0364). The ACE facts and the stale-batch signal are read through the RWB-P1-E1015-CON data-product contract of rwb-source-data, which is the only reader of the recovery.v_ace_* views and owns the interaction ledger (DP-18). The PDF is stored through the rwb-document contract (RWB-P5-E1052-CON). The merge snapshot is kept in rwb-comms as references only. The local decision record is written in rwb-comms and the central entry in rwb-decision (RWB-P7-E1027-CON), and both are proven within five minutes. Every legacy value and message is kept unchanged.
- The case side keeps seven notice columns on recovery_case: notice reference, notice state, hold reason, template code, template version, document reference and delivery date (GAP-0749). They are created by migration V1052_1 with a unique index on case and notice reference and a timeline index. One timeline entry is written per notice request and per delivery, and the notice event codes are loaded into LOV-LEDGER-EVENT through the reference-data contract. The field IDs and the notice event codes are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0749); the data steward supplies them in the next data dictionary version.
- The case-side record of a notice request reuses decision code D7.1 with the template code and version, the notice reference and the business date (GAP-0750). The final call and outcome value of that record are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0750) and are agreed with the decision log owner before build.
- The request task and the hold task use element type HUMAN_TASK and discretion REQUIRED (GAP-0751). The hold task is created from the held answer. A raise that arrives through the case task operation on the same case, task code and business date is deduplicated. The task codes of the request task and the hold task are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0751).
